successCriteria.description: Employee interface is defined in src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts with all 13 fields: id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId, department, hireDate, terminationDate, employmentStatus (imported from shared/types), createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt — with correct TypeScript types including nullable fields

IEmployeeRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<Employee> and declares four additional methods: findByEmployeeNumber(employeeNumber: string): Promise<Employee | null>, findByEmail(email: string): Promise<Employee | null>, findByManagerId(managerId: string): Promise<Employee[]>, findActive(): Promise<Employee[]>

EmployeeRepository class implements IEmployeeRepository using the pg pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts with parameterized SQL queries for all methods (findById, findAll, create, update, delete, findByEmployeeNumber, findByEmail, findByManagerId, findActive)
Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.spec.ts cover findById, findByEmployeeNumber, findByEmail, create, and update with mocked pg pool

constraints: All SQL queries in EmployeeRepository must use parameterized queries (e.g., $1, $2, ...) against the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no string concatenation or template literals for query values
Employee model must import EmploymentStatus from src/shared/types/index.ts (not redefine it)
IEmployeeRepository must extend IBaseRepository<Employee> from src/shared/base.repository.ts
outOfScope: Employee service layer (business logic, validation, RBAC enforcement) — deferred to later phases
Employee routes/controllers/API endpoints — deferred to later phases

ambiguities.description: The IBaseRepository.delete(id) method signature returns Promise<void> and does not specify hard vs soft delete. The Employee model includes a deletedAt: Date | null field, suggesting soft-delete semantics. Should EmployeeRepository.delete perform a soft delete (SET deletedAt = NOW()) or a hard delete (DELETE FROM employees)?
options: Soft delete: UPDATE employees SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
Hard delete: DELETE FROM employees WHERE id = $1
